description: Chinese-learning Quiz draft pack. Chinese is the learning language; optional English secondary text is shown only when English is selected as the translation language. All items require human linguistic and assessment QA before release.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个音节使用第一声？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè yīn jié shǐ yòng dì yī shēng
questions.prompt_translation: Which syllable uses the first tone?
questions.explanation_learning: 第一声保持高而平；“妈”读作 mā，声调是第一声。
questions.explanation_pinyin: dì yī shēng bǎo chí gāo ér píng; “mā” de shēng diào shì dì yī shēng.
questions.explanation_translation: The first tone stays high and level. 妈 is pronounced mā, with the first tone.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个汉字读作第三声的 mǎ？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè hàn zì dú zuò dì sān shēng de
questions.prompt_translation: Which character is pronounced mǎ, with the third tone?
questions.explanation_learning: “马”读作 mǎ，使用第三声；第三声的调号写在元音 a 上。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “mǎ” dú zuò mǎ, shǐ yòng dì sān shēng; dì sān shēng de diào hào xiě zài yuán yīn a shàng.
questions.explanation_translation: 马 is pronounced mǎ with the third tone; its tone mark is written over the vowel a.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪种说法最准确地描述第二声？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ zhǒng shuō fǎ zuì zhǔn què de miáo shù dì èr shēng
questions.prompt_translation: Which statement best describes the second tone?

options.translation_text: The voice starts high and falls.
options.pinyin: shēng yīn xiān gāo hòu dī.

options.translation_text: The voice rises from low to high.
options.pinyin: shēng yīn yóu dī xiàng gāo shàng shēng.

options.translation_text: The voice stays high and level.
options.pinyin: shēng yīn bǎo chí gāo ér píng.
shēng yīn kuài sù xià jiàng.

questions.explanation_learning: 第二声的音高从较低的位置向较高处上升，听起来像上扬的语调。
questions.explanation_pinyin: dì èr shēng de yīn gāo cóng jiào dī de wèi zhì xiàng jiào gāo de wèi zhì shàng shēng.
questions.explanation_translation: The second tone rises from a relatively low pitch to a higher pitch.

questions.prompt_learning: 汉语拼音的主要作用是什么？
questions.prompt_pinyin: hàn yǔ pīn yīn de zhǔ yào zuò yòng shì shén me
questions.prompt_translation: What is the main purpose of Hanyu Pinyin?

options.pinyin: biāo jì pǔ tōng huà de dú yīn.
biǎo shì hàn zì de bǐ huà shùn xù.
dài tì suǒ yǒu hàn zì.
biǎo shì jù zi de yǔ fǎ jié gòu.

questions.explanation_learning: 汉语拼音用字母和声调符号标记普通话读音，帮助学习者认读和学习发音。
questions.explanation_pinyin: hàn yǔ pīn yīn yòng zì mǔ hé shēng diào fú hào biāo jì pǔ tōng huà dú yīn, bāng zhù xué xí zhě rèn dú hé xué xí fā yīn.
questions.explanation_translation: Hanyu Pinyin uses letters and tone marks to represent Mandarin pronunciation and help learners read and practise sounds.

questions.prompt_learning: 在“妈妈”中，哪个音节通常读轻声？
questions.prompt_pinyin: zài “mā ma” zhōng, nǎ ge yīn jié tōng cháng dú qīng shēng?
questions.prompt_translation: Which syllable in 妈妈 is normally pronounced with the neutral tone?

options.translation_text: Both syllables use the first tone.
options.pinyin: liǎng gè dōu shì dì yī shēng

options.translation_text: Both syllables use the fourth tone.
options.pinyin: liǎng gè dōu shì dì sì shēng

questions.explanation_learning: 在“妈妈”中，第二个“妈”通常读轻声 ma，发音较轻、较短，不标第一声。
questions.explanation_pinyin: zài “mā ma” zhōng, dì èr gè “ma” tōng cháng dú qīng shēng, fā yīn jiào qīng, jiào duǎn, bù biāo dì yī shēng.
questions.explanation_translation: In 妈妈, the second syllable is usually the neutral-tone ma, spoken lightly and briefly without a first-tone mark.

questions.prompt_learning: “你好”的标准拼音写法是什么？
questions.prompt_pinyin: “nǐ hǎo” de biāo zhǔn pīn yīn xiě fǎ shì shén me?
questions.prompt_translation: Which spelling is the standard written pinyin for 你好?

options.translation_text: Incorrect tone on the second syllable.
Incorrect tone on the first syllable.

questions.explanation_learning: 标准拼音书写保留“你”和“好”各自的本调，因此写作 nǐ hǎo；连读时第一个三声会发生变调。
questions.explanation_pinyin: biāo zhǔn pīn yīn shū xiě bǎ “nǐ” hé “hǎo” gè zì de běn lái shēng diào bǎo liú xià lái, suǒ yǐ xiě zuò nǐ hǎo; lián dú shí dì yī gè sān shēng huì biàn diào.
questions.explanation_translation: Standard written Pinyin keeps the underlying tones of 你 and 好, so it is written nǐ hǎo. In connected speech, the first third tone changes.

questions.prompt_learning: 关于第三声，哪种说法最准确？
questions.prompt_pinyin: guān yú dì sān shēng nǎ zhǒng shuō fǎ zuì zhǔn què
questions.prompt_translation: Which statement about the third tone is most accurate?

options.learning_text: 它总是完整地先降后升。
options.translation_text: It always fully falls and then rises.
options.pinyin: tā zǒng shì wán zhěng de xiān jiàng hòu shēng.

options.learning_text: 它在单独读或句末时常呈现先降后升。
options.translation_text: When spoken alone or at the end of a phrase, it often dips and rises.
options.pinyin: tā zài dān dú huò jù mò shí cháng chéng xiàn xiān jiàng hòu shēng.

options.learning_text: 它的音高始终保持不变。
options.translation_text: Its pitch always stays the same.
options.pinyin: tā de yīn gāo shǐ zhōng bǎo chí bù biàn.
tā zǒng shì kuài sù xià jiàng.

questions.explanation_learning: 第三声在单独读或位于词组末尾时，常呈现先降后升；在其他语流位置也可能只读半三声。
questions.explanation_pinyin: dì sān shēng zài dān dú huò wèi yú cí zǔ mò wěi shí, cháng chéng xiàn xiān jiàng hòu shēng; zài qí tā lián dú wèi zhì yě kě néng zhǐ dú bàn sān shēng.
questions.explanation_translation: When spoken alone or at the end of a phrase, the third tone often dips and rises. In other connected-speech positions, it may be a half-third tone.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个表达表示“早上好”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè biǎo dá biǎo shì zǎo shàng hǎo
questions.prompt_translation: Which expression means “Good morning”?
questions.explanation_learning: “早上好”是早晨见面时常用的问候语。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “zǎo shang hǎo” shì zǎo chén jiàn miàn shí cháng yòng de wèn hòu yǔ.
questions.explanation_translation: 早上好 is a common greeting used when meeting someone in the morning.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个表达表示“谢谢”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè biǎo dá biǎo shì xiè xiè
questions.prompt_translation: Which expression means “Thank you”?
questions.explanation_learning: “谢谢”用来表达对他人的帮助、礼物或好意的感谢。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “xiè xie” yòng lái biǎo dá duì tā rén de bāng zhù, lǐ wù huò hǎo yì de gǎn xiè.
questions.explanation_translation: 谢谢 expresses gratitude for someone's help, gift or kindness.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个短语可以礼貌地引出一个问题？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè duǎn yǔ kě yǐ lǐ mào de yǐn chū yī gè wèn tí
questions.prompt_translation: Which phrase politely introduces a question?
questions.explanation_learning: “请问”常放在问题前，用来礼貌地引起对方注意并提出询问。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “qǐng wèn” cháng fàng zài wèn tí qián, yòng lái lǐ mào de yǐn qǐ duì fāng zhù yì bìng tí chū xún wèn.
questions.explanation_translation: 请问 is commonly placed before a question to politely get someone's attention and make an enquiry.

questions.prompt_learning: 回应“谢谢”时，哪种说法最自然？
questions.prompt_pinyin: huí yìng “xiè xie” shí, nǎ zhǒng shuō fǎ zuì zì rán?
questions.prompt_translation: Which is a natural reply to 谢谢?
questions.explanation_learning: “不客气”常用于回应“谢谢”，表示对方不必特别客气。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “bú kè qi” cháng yòng yú huí yìng “xiè xie”, biǎo shì duì fāng bù bì tè bié kè qi.
questions.explanation_translation: 不客气 is a natural response to 谢谢, meaning that the other person need not mention it.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个表达表示“再见”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè biǎo dá biǎo shì zài jiàn
questions.prompt_translation: Which expression means “Goodbye”?
questions.explanation_learning: “再见”用于分别时，表达希望之后再次见面的意思。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “zài jiàn” yòng yú fēn bié shí, biǎo dá xī wàng zhī hòu zài cì jiàn miàn de yì si.
questions.explanation_translation: 再见 is used when parting and conveys the idea of seeing the person again.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个句子表示“我叫李明”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè jù zǐ biǎo shì wǒ jiào lǐ míng
questions.prompt_translation: Which sentence means “My name is Li Ming”?

options.pinyin: nǐ jiào shén me míng zi

questions.explanation_learning: “我叫李明”是介绍姓名的常见说法，意思是“我的名字是李明”。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “wǒ jiào Lǐ Míng” shì jiè shào xìng míng de cháng jiàn shuō fǎ, yì si shì “wǒ de míng zi shì Lǐ Míng”.
questions.explanation_translation: 我叫李明 is a common way to introduce a name; it means “My name is Li Ming.”

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个短语表示“很高兴认识你”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè duǎn yǔ biǎo shì hěn gāo xìng rèn shí nǐ
questions.prompt_translation: Which phrase means “Nice to meet you”?

options.pinyin: hěn gāo xìng rèn shi nǐ

questions.explanation_learning: “很高兴认识你”常用于初次见面，表达认识对方很愉快。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “hěn gāo xìng rèn shi nǐ” cháng yòng yú chū cì jiàn miàn, biǎo dá rèn shi duì fāng hěn yú kuài.
questions.explanation_translation: 很高兴认识你 is used when meeting someone for the first time to say that you are pleased to meet them.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个汉字表示数字七？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè hàn zì biǎo shì shù zì qī
questions.prompt_translation: Which character is the number seven?
questions.explanation_learning: “七”表示数字 7，普通话读作 qī，使用第一声。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “qī” biǎo shì shù zì qī, pǔ tōng huà dú zuò qī, shǐ yòng dì yī shēng.
questions.explanation_translation: 七 means the number seven and is pronounced qī with the first tone.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个词表示“今天”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè cí biǎo shì jīn tiān
questions.prompt_translation: Which word means “today”?
questions.explanation_learning: “今天”指说话当天，也就是 today。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “jīn tiān” zhǐ shuō huà dāng tiān.
questions.explanation_translation: 今天 refers to the current day, meaning “today.”

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个表达表示星期一？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè biǎo dá biǎo shì xīng qī yī
questions.prompt_translation: Which expression means Monday?
questions.explanation_learning: “星期一”表示一周中的星期一，对应英语 Monday。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “xīng qī yī” biǎo shì yì zhōu zhōng de xīng qī yī.
questions.explanation_translation: 星期一 is the first weekday in the standard Monday-to-Sunday naming sequence and means Monday.

questions.prompt_learning: 日期中的哪个汉字表示“月”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: rì qī zhōng de nǎ gè hàn zì biǎo shì yuè
questions.prompt_translation: Which character means “month” in a date?
questions.explanation_learning: “月”表示月份；日期表达中通常放在数字后面，例如“三月”。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “yuè” biǎo shì yuè fèn; zài yuè fèn biǎo dá zhōng tōng cháng fàng zài shù zì hòu miàn, lì rú “sān yuè”.
questions.explanation_translation: 月 means “month” and follows a number in a month expression, such as 三月 (March).

questions.prompt_learning: 中文日期通常按什么顺序排列？
questions.prompt_pinyin: zhōng wén rì qī tōng cháng àn shén me shùn xù pái liè
questions.prompt_translation: What is the usual Chinese date order?
questions.explanation_learning: 中文日期通常按从大到小的顺序排列：年、月、日。
questions.explanation_pinyin: zhōng wén rì qī tōng cháng àn cóng dà dào xiǎo de shùn xù pái liè: nián, yuè, rì.
questions.explanation_translation: Chinese dates normally follow a largest-to-smallest order: year, month, then day.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个词表示“明天”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè cí biǎo shì míng tiān
questions.prompt_translation: Which word means “tomorrow”?
questions.explanation_learning: “明天”指今天之后的一天，也就是 tomorrow。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “míng tiān” zhǐ jīn tiān zhī hòu de yì tiān.
questions.explanation_translation: 明天 refers to the day after today, meaning “tomorrow.”

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个代词表示“我”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè dài cí biǎo shì wǒ
questions.prompt_translation: Which pronoun means “I”?
questions.explanation_learning: “我”是第一人称单数代词，指说话的人自己。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “wǒ” shì dì yī rén chēng dān shù dài cí, zhǐ shuō huà de rén zì jǐ.
questions.explanation_translation: 我 is the first-person singular pronoun and refers to the speaker.

questions.prompt_learning: 表示女性“她”时通常写哪个汉字？
questions.prompt_pinyin: biǎo shì nǚ xìng tā shí tōng cháng xiě nǎ gè hàn zì
questions.prompt_translation: Which character is normally written for “she”?
questions.explanation_learning: “她”是书写中表示女性第三人称的汉字；它与“他”读音相同，都是 tā。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “tā” shì shū xiě zhōng biǎo shì nǚ xìng dì sān rén chēng de hàn zì; tā hé “他” dú yīn xiāng tóng.
questions.explanation_translation: 她 is the written third-person pronoun for a female. It is pronounced tā, the same as 他.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个词表示“我们”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè cí biǎo shì wǒ men
questions.prompt_translation: Which word means “we”?
questions.explanation_learning: “我们”是第一人称复数，表示说话者和至少一位其他人。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “wǒ men” shì dì yī rén chēng fù shù, biǎo shì shuō huà zhě hé zhì shǎo yí wèi qí tā rén.
questions.explanation_translation: 我们 is the first-person plural pronoun, referring to the speaker and at least one other person.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个句子表示“我是学生”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè jù zǐ biǎo shì wǒ shì xué shēng
questions.prompt_translation: Which sentence means “I am a student”?
questions.explanation_learning: “我是学生”由“我 + 是 + 学生”组成，意思是“I am a student”。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “wǒ shì xué shēng” yóu “wǒ + shì + xué shēng” zǔ chéng, yì si shì “wǒ shì yí míng xué shēng”.
questions.explanation_translation: 我是学生 follows the pattern 我 + 是 + 学生 and means “I am a student.”

questions.prompt_learning: 在“我是学生”这样的句子中，哪个词用来说明身份？
questions.prompt_pinyin: zài “wǒ shì xué shēng” zhè yàng de jù zi zhōng, nǎ ge cí yòng lái shuō míng shēn fèn?
questions.prompt_translation: Which word links a person to an identity, as in 我是学生?
questions.explanation_learning: 在这个句型中，“是”连接主语和身份或名词性说明，相当于英语中的 be。
questions.explanation_pinyin: zài zhè ge jù xíng zhōng, “shì” lián jiē zhǔ yǔ hé shēn fèn huò míng cí xìng shuō míng.
questions.explanation_translation: In this sentence pattern, 是 links the subject to an identity or noun phrase, similar to “be” in English.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个句子表示“这是我的书”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè jù zǐ biǎo shì zhè shì wǒ de shū
questions.prompt_translation: Which sentence means “This is my book”?
questions.explanation_learning: “这是我的书”中，“这”指 this，“是”连接说明，“我的”表示所属，“书”是物品。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “zhè shì wǒ de shū” zhōng, “zhè” zhǐ dài zhè yí jiàn shì wù, “shì” lián jiē shuō míng, “wǒ de” biǎo shì suǒ shǔ, “shū” shì wù pǐn.
questions.explanation_translation: In 这是我的书, 这 means “this,” 是 links the description, 我的 marks possession, and 书 means “book.”

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个动词表示“吃”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè dòng cí biǎo shì chī
questions.prompt_translation: Which verb means “to eat”?
questions.explanation_learning: “吃”表示进食，是常见的动作动词，例如“吃饭”和“吃水果”。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “chī” biǎo shì jìn shí, shì cháng jiàn de dòng zuò dòng cí, lì rú “chī fàn” hé “chī shuǐ guǒ”.
questions.explanation_translation: 吃 means “to eat” and is a common action verb, as in 吃饭 and 吃水果.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个动词表示“喝”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè dòng cí biǎo shì hē
questions.prompt_translation: Which verb means “to drink”?
questions.explanation_learning: “喝”表示饮用，后面通常接水、茶、咖啡等饮料。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “hē” biǎo shì yǐn yòng, hòu miàn tōng cháng jiē shuǐ, chá, kā fēi děng yǐn liào.
questions.explanation_translation: 喝 means “to drink” and is usually followed by a beverage such as water, tea or coffee.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个动词表示“去”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè dòng cí biǎo shì qù
questions.prompt_translation: Which verb means “to go”?
questions.explanation_learning: “去”表示从当前位置前往某处，后面常接地点，例如“去学校”。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “qù” biǎo shì cóng dāng qián wèi zhì qián wǎng mǒu chù, hòu miàn cháng jiē dì diǎn, lì rú “qù xué xiào”.
questions.explanation_translation: 去 means “to go” and is commonly followed by a destination, as in 去学校.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个句子表示“我喝水”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè jù zǐ biǎo shì wǒ hē shuǐ
questions.prompt_translation: Which sentence means “I drink water”?
questions.explanation_learning: “我喝水”按“主语 + 动词 + 宾语”排列：我是主语，喝是动词，水是宾语。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “wǒ hē shuǐ” àn “zhǔ yǔ + dòng cí + bīn yǔ” pái liè: “wǒ” shì zhǔ yǔ, “hē” shì dòng cí, “shuǐ” shì bīn yǔ.
questions.explanation_translation: 我喝水 follows subject–verb–object order: 我 is the subject, 喝 the verb, and 水 the object.

questions.prompt_learning: 与书一起使用时，哪个动词可以表示“阅读”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: yǔ shū yī qǐ shǐ yòng shí nǎ gè dòng cí kě yǐ biǎo shì yuè dú
questions.prompt_translation: Which verb can mean “to read” when used with a book?
questions.explanation_learning: “看书”是常见搭配，表示阅读；“看”单独使用时也可以表示看见或观看。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “kàn shū” shì cháng jiàn dā pèi, biǎo shì yuè dú; “kàn” dān dú shǐ yòng shí yě kě yǐ biǎo shì kàn jiàn huò guān kàn.
questions.explanation_translation: 看书 is a common collocation meaning “to read.” 看 can also mean “to look at” or “to watch” in other contexts.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个词表示“学习”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè cí biǎo shì xué xí
questions.prompt_translation: Which word means “to study” or “to learn”?
questions.explanation_learning: “学习”表示获取知识或练习技能，可以作动词使用，例如“学习中文”。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “xué xí” biǎo shì huò qǔ zhī shi huò liàn xí jì néng, kě yǐ zuò dòng cí shǐ yòng, lì rú “xué xí zhōng wén”.
questions.explanation_translation: 学习 means “to study” or “to learn” and can be used as a verb, as in 学习中文.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个词表示“学校”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè cí biǎo shì xué xiào
questions.prompt_translation: Which word means “school”?
questions.explanation_learning: “学校”是学习和上课的地方，对应英语 school。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “xué xiào” shì xué xí hé shàng kè de dì fāng.
questions.explanation_translation: 学校 is a place for studying and attending classes; it means “school.”

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个词表示“医院”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè cí biǎo shì yī yuàn
questions.prompt_translation: Which word means “hospital”?
questions.explanation_learning: “医院”是提供诊断和医疗服务的地方，对应英语 hospital。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “yī yuàn” shì tí gōng zhěn duàn hé yī liáo fú wù de dì fāng.
questions.explanation_translation: 医院 is a place that provides diagnosis and medical care; it means “hospital.”

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个词表示“车站”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè cí biǎo shì chē zhàn
questions.prompt_translation: Which word means “station”?
questions.explanation_learning: “车站”泛指车辆停靠和乘客上下车的站点；具体可用“火车站”或“汽车站”。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “chē zhàn” fàn zhǐ chē liàng tíng kào hé chéng kè shàng xià chē de zhàn diǎn; jù tǐ kě yòng “huǒ chē zhàn” huò “qì chē zhàn”.
questions.explanation_translation: 车站 is a general term for a transport station where vehicles stop and passengers board or alight; specific types include train and bus stations.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个句子是在问“地铁站在哪里”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè jù zǐ shì zài wèn de tiě zhàn zài nǎ lǐ
questions.prompt_translation: Which sentence asks “Where is the subway station?”

options.pinyin: dì tiě zhàn zài nǎ lǐ?
dì tiě zhàn shì shén me?

options.translation_text: I am going to the subway station.

questions.explanation_learning: “地铁站在哪里？”用“地点 + 在哪里”询问某个地方的位置。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “dì tiě zhàn zài nǎ lǐ” yòng “dì diǎn + zài nǎ lǐ” xún wèn mǒu gè dì fāng de wèi zhì.
questions.explanation_translation: 地铁站在哪里? asks for a location using the pattern “place + 在哪里” (where is the place?).

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个词表示“左边”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè cí biǎo shì zuǒ biān
questions.prompt_translation: Which word means “left side”?
questions.explanation_learning: “左边”表示左侧；“左”表示 left，“边”表示 side。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “zuǒ biān” biǎo shì zuǒ cè; “zuǒ” biǎo shì zuǒ, “biān” biǎo shì cè.
questions.explanation_translation: 左边 means “the left side”: 左 means “left” and 边 means “side.”

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个词表示“右边”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè cí biǎo shì yòu biān
questions.prompt_translation: Which word means “right side”?
questions.explanation_learning: “右边”表示右侧，与“左边”相对；“右”表示 right，“边”表示 side。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “yòu biān” biǎo shì yòu cè, yǔ “zuǒ biān” xiāng duì; “yòu” biǎo shì yòu, “biān” biǎo shì cè.
questions.explanation_translation: 右边 means “the right side,” opposite 左边; 右 means “right” and 边 means “side.”

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个助词常用于构成是非疑问句？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè zhù cí cháng yòng yú gòu chéng shì fēi yí wèn jù
questions.prompt_translation: Which particle commonly forms a yes/no question?
questions.explanation_learning: “吗”通常放在陈述句末尾，把陈述句变成是非疑问句，语序一般不变。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “ma” tōng cháng fàng zài chén shù jù mò wěi, bǎ chén shù jù biàn chéng shì fǒu yí wèn jù, yǔ xù yì bān bù biàn.
questions.explanation_translation: 吗 is usually placed at the end of a statement to turn it into a yes/no question; the word order generally stays the same.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个词表示“什么”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè cí biǎo shì shén me
questions.prompt_translation: Which word means “what”?
questions.explanation_learning: “什么”用来询问事物、内容或名称，相当于英语 what。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “shén me” yòng lái xún wèn shì wù, nèi róng huò míng chēng.
questions.explanation_translation: 什么 asks about a thing, information or a name; it means “what.”

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个词表示“谁”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè cí biǎo shì shéi
questions.prompt_translation: Which word means “who”?
questions.explanation_learning: “谁”用来询问人物身份或姓名，相当于英语 who。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “shéi” yòng lái xún wèn rén wù shēn fèn huò xìng míng.
questions.explanation_translation: 谁 asks about a person's identity or name; it means “who.”

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个词常用于否定一般陈述，例如“我不喜欢它”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè cí cháng yòng yú fǒu dìng yī bān chén shù lì rú wǒ bù xǐ huān tā
questions.prompt_translation: Which word commonly negates a general statement such as “I do not like it”?
questions.explanation_learning: “不”常用于否定一般事实、习惯或当前意愿，例如“不喜欢”；过去发生的动作通常使用“没”。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “bù” cháng yòng yú fǒu dìng yì bān shì shí, xí guàn huò dāng qián yì yuàn, lì rú “bù xǐ huan”; guò qù fā shēng de dòng zuò tōng cháng shǐ yòng “méi”.
questions.explanation_translation: 不 commonly negates general facts, habits or present intentions, as in 不喜欢. 没 is generally used to negate completed past actions.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个表达可以表示“没有”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè biǎo dá kě yǐ biǎo shì méi yǒu
questions.prompt_translation: Which expression can mean “do not have”?
questions.explanation_learning: “没有”可以表示不存在或不拥有，也常用于否定“有”，例如“我没有时间”。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “méi yǒu” kě yǐ biǎo shì bù cún zài huò bù yōng yǒu, yě cháng yòng yú fǒu dìng “yǒu”, lì rú “wǒ méi yǒu shí jiān”.
questions.explanation_translation: 没有 can mean “there is not” or “do not have,” and commonly negates 有, as in 我没有时间.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个句子表示“你是学生吗”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè jù zǐ biǎo shì nǐ shì xué shēng ma
questions.prompt_translation: Which sentence means “Are you a student?”

options.translation_text: You are what kind of student.
options.pinyin: nǐ shì shén me xué sheng.

questions.explanation_learning: “吗”放在“你是学生”后面形成是非疑问句，意思是“你是学生吗？”
questions.explanation_pinyin: “ma” fàng zài “nǐ shì xué shēng” hòu miàn xíng chéng shì fǒu yí wèn jù, yì si shì “nǐ shì xué shēng ma”.
questions.explanation_translation: Adding 吗 after 你是学生 turns the statement into a yes/no question: “Are you a student?”

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个量词通常用于书？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè liàng cí tōng cháng yòng yú shū
questions.prompt_translation: Which measure word is commonly used for books?
questions.explanation_learning: “本”是书籍、杂志等装订成册物品的常用量词。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “běn” shì shū jí, zá zhì děng zhuāng dìng chéng cè wù pǐn de cháng yòng liàng cí.
questions.explanation_translation: 本 is the usual measure word for bound volumes such as books and magazines.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个短语表示“两本书”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè duǎn yǔ biǎo shì liǎng běn shū
questions.prompt_translation: Which phrase means “two books”?
questions.explanation_learning: “两本书”由数字“两”、量词“本”和名词“书”组成。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “liǎng běn shū” yóu shù zì “liǎng”, liàng cí “běn” hé míng cí “shū” zǔ chéng.
questions.explanation_translation: 两本书 consists of the number 两, the measure word 本 and the noun 书.

questions.prompt_learning: 一杯水通常使用哪个量词？
questions.prompt_pinyin: yī bēi shuǐ tōng cháng shǐ yòng nǎ gè liàng cí
questions.prompt_translation: Which measure word is suitable for a glass of water?
questions.explanation_learning: “杯”用于以杯为单位的饮料，例如“一杯水”或“两杯茶”。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “bēi” yòng yú yǐ bēi wéi dān wèi de yǐn liào, lì rú “yì bēi shuǐ” huò “liǎng bēi chá”.
questions.explanation_translation: 杯 measures drinks served by the cup, as in 一杯水 or 两杯茶.

questions.prompt_learning: 一张纸通常使用哪个量词？
questions.prompt_pinyin: yī zhāng zhǐ tōng cháng shǐ yòng nǎ gè liàng cí
questions.prompt_translation: Which measure word is commonly used for a sheet of paper?
questions.explanation_learning: “张”常用于纸、桌子、票等平面或张开的物品。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “zhāng” cháng yòng yú zhǐ, zhuō zi, piào děng píng miàn huò zhāng kāi de wù pǐn.
questions.explanation_translation: 张 is commonly used for flat or spread-out items such as paper, tables and tickets.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个量词用于礼貌地称呼一个人？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè liàng cí yòng yú lǐ mào de chēng hū yī gè rén
questions.prompt_translation: Which is a polite measure word for a person?
questions.explanation_learning: “位”是称呼或提及人物时较礼貌、尊敬的量词。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “wèi” shì chēng hu hòu tí jí rén wù shí jiào lǐ mào, zūn jìng de liàng cí.
questions.explanation_translation: 位 is a polite and respectful measure word used when referring to people.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个短语表示“一个人”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè duǎn yǔ biǎo shì yī gè rén
questions.prompt_translation: Which phrase means “one person”?
questions.explanation_learning: “一个人”使用通用量词“个”；“一”在第四声的“个”前读作 yí。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “yí gè rén” shǐ yòng tōng yòng liàng cí “gè”; “yī” zài dì sì shēng de “gè” qián dú zuò yí.
questions.explanation_translation: 一个人 uses the general measure word 个. 一 is pronounced yí before the fourth-tone 个.

questions.prompt_learning: 在量词前表示“二”时，通常使用哪个数字？
questions.prompt_pinyin: zài liàng cí qián biǎo shì èr shí tōng cháng shǐ yòng nǎ gè shù zì
questions.prompt_translation: Which number is commonly used before a measure word to mean “two”?
questions.explanation_learning: 量词前表示两个时，通常用“两”，例如“两本书”，而不是“二本书”。
questions.explanation_pinyin: liàng cí qián biǎo shì liǎng gè shí, tōng cháng yòng “liǎng”, lì rú “liǎng běn shū”, ér bù shì “èr běn shū”.
questions.explanation_translation: Before a measure word, 两 is normally used for two items, as in 两本书, rather than 二本书.

questions.prompt_learning: 在“我的书”中，哪个助词通常表示所属关系？
questions.prompt_pinyin: zài “wǒ de shū” zhōng, nǎ ge zhù cí tōng cháng biǎo shì suǒ shǔ guān xì?
questions.prompt_translation: Which particle commonly marks possession in 我的书?
questions.explanation_learning: “的”连接修饰语和名词，也常用来标记所属关系；“我的书”表示这本书属于我。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “de” lián jiē xiū shì yǔ hé míng cí, yě cháng yòng lái biāo jì suǒ shǔ guān xì; “wǒ de shū” biǎo shì zhè běn shū shǔ yú wǒ.
questions.explanation_translation: 的 links a modifier to a noun and often marks possession. 我的书 means the book belongs to me.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个句子表示“我昨天看了电影”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè jù zǐ biǎo shì wǒ zuó tiān kàn le diàn yǐng
questions.prompt_translation: Which sentence says “I watched a movie yesterday”?

options.pinyin: wǒ zuó tiān kàn le diàn yǐng

options.translation_text: Have I ever watched a movie yesterday?
options.pinyin: wǒ zuó tiān kàn guo diàn yǐng ma
wǒ diàn yǐng zuó tiān kàn zhe
wǒ zuó tiān diàn yǐng le kàn

questions.explanation_learning: “了”放在动词“看”后，表示看电影这一动作已经发生或完成。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “le” fàng zài dòng cí “kàn” hòu, biǎo shì kàn diàn yǐng zhè yí dòng zuò yǐ jīng fā shēng huò wán chéng.
questions.explanation_translation: 了 after the verb 看 marks the movie-watching event as having occurred or been completed.

questions.prompt_learning: 在“我去过北京”中，哪个助词表示曾经有过某种经历？
questions.prompt_pinyin: zài “wǒ qù guo běi jīng” zhōng, nǎ ge zhù cí biǎo shì céng jīng yǒu guo mǒu zhǒng jīng lì?
questions.prompt_translation: Which particle often marks an experience, as in 我去过北京?
questions.explanation_learning: 动词后的“过”表示曾经有过某种经历；“去过北京”表示以前有去北京的经历。
questions.explanation_pinyin: dòng cí hòu de “guo” biǎo shì céng jīng yǒu guò mǒu zhǒng jīng lì; “qù guo běi jīng” biǎo shì yǐ qián qù guò běi jīng.
questions.explanation_translation: 过 after a verb marks experience. 去过北京 means that the person has been to Beijing before.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个句子描述门保持开着的状态？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè jù zǐ miáo shù mén bǎo chí kāi zhe de zhuàng tài
questions.prompt_translation: Which sentence describes a door remaining open?
questions.explanation_learning: “着”放在“开”后，强调门处于打开的持续状态，而不是只说明打开的动作。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “zhe” fàng zài “kāi” hòu, qiáng diào mén chǔ yú dǎ kāi de chí xù zhuàng tài, ér bù shì zhǐ shuō míng dǎ kāi de dòng zuò.
questions.explanation_translation: 着 after 开 emphasises the continuing state of the door being open, rather than just the action of opening it.

questions.prompt_learning: 在“我们走吧”中，哪个助词可以表示建议？
questions.prompt_pinyin: zài “wǒ men zǒu ba” zhōng, nǎ ge zhù cí kě yǐ biǎo shì jiàn yì?
questions.prompt_translation: Which particle can mark a suggestion in 我们走吧?
questions.explanation_learning: 句末的“吧”可以让建议或提议听起来更委婉，例如“我们走吧”。
questions.explanation_pinyin: jù mò de “ba” kě yǐ ràng jiàn yì huò tí yì tīng qǐ lái gèng wěi wǎn, lì rú “wǒ men zǒu ba”.
questions.explanation_translation: Sentence-final 吧 can soften a suggestion or proposal, as in 我们走吧.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个句子表示“你呢”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè jù zǐ biǎo shì nǐ ne
questions.prompt_translation: Which sentence means “What about you?”
questions.explanation_learning: “呢”放在“你”后面，可以承接前文并询问对方的情况，相当于“你呢？”
questions.explanation_pinyin: “ne” fàng zài “nǐ” hòu miàn, kě yǐ chéng jiē qián wén bìng xún wèn duì fāng de qíng kuàng.
questions.explanation_translation: 呢 after 你 can continue the topic and ask about the other person, like “And you?”

questions.prompt_learning: 下面哪句话用“得”来补充说明一个人跑步的状态？
questions.prompt_pinyin: xià miàn nǎ jù huà yòng “de” lái bǔ chōng shuō míng yí ge rén pǎo bù de zhuàng tài?
questions.prompt_translation: Which sentence uses 得 to describe how someone runs?

options.translation_text: Common informal spelling, but 得 is the standard complement marker

questions.explanation_learning: “得”放在动词“跑”后，引出程度或状态补语；“跑得很快”说明跑步的速度。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “de” fàng zài dòng cí “pǎo” hòu, yǐn chū chéng dù huò zhuàng tài bǔ yǔ; “pǎo de hěn kuài” shuō míng pǎo bù de sù dù.
questions.explanation_translation: 得 after 跑 introduces a complement describing degree or manner. 跑得很快 describes the speed of running.

questions.prompt_learning: 在“我明天去学校”中，“明天”通常放在什么位置？
questions.prompt_pinyin: zài “wǒ míng tiān qù xué xiào” zhōng, “míng tiān” tōng cháng fàng zài shén me wèi zhì?
questions.prompt_translation: Where does 明天 usually appear in 我明天去学校?

options.pinyin: zài zhǔ yào dòng cí zhī qián
zài dòng cí hé dì diǎn zhī jiān

questions.explanation_learning: 时间词“明天”通常放在主语之后、主要动词之前，例如“我明天去学校”。
questions.explanation_pinyin: shí jiān cí “míng tiān” tōng cháng fàng zài zhǔ yǔ zhī hòu, zhǔ yào dòng cí zhī qián, lì rú “wǒ míng tiān qù xué xiào”.
questions.explanation_translation: The time expression 明天 usually appears after the subject and before the main verb, as in 我明天去学校.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个表达表示“每天”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè biǎo dá biǎo shì měi tiān
questions.prompt_translation: Which expression means “every day”?
questions.explanation_learning: “每天”表示每一个日子，常用于说明重复发生的习惯或日常安排。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “měi tiān” biǎo shì měi yí gè rì zi, cháng yòng yú shuō míng chóng fù fā shēng de xí guàn huò rì cháng ān pái.
questions.explanation_translation: 每天 means “every day” and is often used for recurring habits or routines.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个表达表示“已经”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè biǎo dá biǎo shì yǐ jīng
questions.prompt_translation: Which expression means “already”?
questions.explanation_learning: “已经”表示某件事到现在为止发生或达到某种状态，英语常译为 already。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “yǐ jīng” biǎo shì mǒu jiàn shì dào xiàn zài wéi zhǐ yǐ fā shēng huò dá dào mǒu zhǒng zhuàng tài.
questions.explanation_translation: 已经 indicates that something has happened or reached a state by now; it often means “already.”

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个表达表示“还没”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè biǎo dá biǎo shì hái méi
questions.prompt_translation: Which expression means “not yet”?
questions.explanation_learning: “还没”表示某件事到目前为止尚未发生，常相当于“not yet”。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “hái méi” biǎo shì mǒu jiàn shì dào mù qián wéi zhǐ shàng wèi fā shēng.
questions.explanation_translation: 还没 indicates that something has not happened up to the present; it means “not yet.”

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个句子表示“我每天早上七点起床”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè jù zǐ biǎo shì wǒ měi tiān zǎo shàng qī diǎn qǐ chuáng
questions.prompt_translation: Which sentence means “I get up at seven every morning”?

options.translation_text: I get up at seven every morning
options.pinyin: wǒ měi tiān zǎo shang qī diǎn qǐ chuáng
wǒ qǐ chuáng měi tiān qī diǎn zǎo shang
wǒ qī diǎn měi tiān qǐ chuáng zǎo shang

options.learning_text: 我每天起床早上七点吗
options.pinyin: wǒ měi tiān qǐ chuáng zǎo shang qī diǎn ma

questions.explanation_learning: “我每天早上七点起床”按主语、时间和动作排列，说明说话者每天早上七点起床。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “wǒ měi tiān zǎo shang qī diǎn qǐ chuáng” àn zhǔ yǔ, shí jiān hé dòng zuò pái liè, shuō míng shuō huà zhě měi tiān zǎo shang qī diǎn qǐ chuáng.
questions.explanation_translation: 我每天早上七点起床 places the subject before the time expressions and action; it means the speaker gets up at seven every morning.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个词表示“下午”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè cí biǎo shì xià wǔ
questions.prompt_translation: Which word means “afternoon”?
questions.explanation_learning: “下午”指中午之后、晚上之前的一段时间。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “xià wǔ” zhǐ zhōng wǔ zhī hòu, wǎn shang zhī qián de yí duàn shí jiān.
questions.explanation_translation: 下午 refers to the period after noon and before evening; it means “afternoon.”

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个句子表示“我还没吃晚饭”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè jù zǐ biǎo shì wǒ hái méi chī wǎn fàn
questions.prompt_translation: Which sentence says “I have not eaten dinner yet”?

options.translation_text: I have not eaten dinner yet
options.pinyin: wǒ hái méi chī wǎn fàn
wǒ yǐ jīng chī wǎn fàn
wǒ měi tiān chī wǎn fàn
wǒ míng tiān chī wǎn fàn

questions.explanation_learning: “还没”放在动词短语前，表示晚饭到说话时仍未吃；“吃晚饭”是动词加宾语。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “hái méi” fàng zài dòng cí duǎn yǔ qián, biǎo shì wǎn fàn dào shuō huà shí réng wèi chī; “chī wǎn fàn” shì dòng cí jiā bīn yǔ.
questions.explanation_translation: 还没 before the verb phrase indicates that dinner has not been eaten yet; 吃晚饭 is a verb-object phrase.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪种句型表示“A比B更……”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ zhǒng jù xíng biǎo shì bǐ gèng
questions.prompt_translation: Which pattern means “A is more ... than B”?

options.pinyin: A bǐ B jiā xíng róng cí

questions.explanation_learning: “A比B + 形容词”用于比较A和B在某个性质上的差异。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “A bǐ B + xíng róng cí” yòng yú bǐ jiào A hé B zài mǒu gè xìng zhì shàng de chā yì.
questions.explanation_translation: The pattern A比B + adjective compares a quality of A with the same quality of B.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个句子表示“我比他高”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè jù zǐ biǎo shì wǒ bǐ tā gāo
questions.prompt_translation: Which sentence means “I am taller than him”?

options.translation_text: I am as tall as him
options.pinyin: wǒ gēn tā yí yàng gāo

options.translation_text: I am not as tall as him

questions.explanation_learning: “我比他高”用“比”引出比较对象，形容词“高”说明我比他更高。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “wǒ bǐ tā gāo” yòng “bǐ” yǐn chū bǐ jiào duì xiàng, xíng róng cí “gāo” shuō míng wǒ bǐ tā gèng gāo.
questions.explanation_translation: 我比他高 uses 比 to introduce the comparison; 高 states that I am taller than him.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个词常用于表示最高级？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè cí cháng yòng yú biǎo shì zuì gāo jí
questions.prompt_translation: Which word commonly marks a superlative?
questions.explanation_learning: “最”放在形容词或动词短语前，表示在比较范围内程度最高。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “zuì” fàng zài xíng róng cí huò dòng cí duǎn yǔ qián, biǎo shì zài bǐ jiào fàn wéi nèi chéng dù zuì gāo.
questions.explanation_translation: 最 appears before an adjective or verb phrase to indicate the highest degree within a comparison group.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个短语表示“和……一样大”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè duǎn yǔ biǎo shì hé yī yàng dà
questions.prompt_translation: Which phrase means “as big as”?
questions.explanation_learning: “一样大”表示两个对象大小相同；“一样”表示相同，“大”说明比较的性质。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “yí yàng dà” biǎo shì liǎng gè duì xiàng dà xiǎo xiāng tóng; “yí yàng” biǎo shì xiāng tóng, “dà” shuō míng bǐ jiào de xìng zhì.
questions.explanation_translation: 一样大 means that two things are the same size: 一样 means “the same,” and 大 gives the quality being compared.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个句子表示“今天比昨天冷”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè jù zǐ biǎo shì jīn tiān bǐ zuó tiān lěng
questions.prompt_translation: Which sentence means “Today is colder than yesterday”?

options.pinyin: jīn tiān bǐ zuó tiān lěng
zuó tiān bǐ jīn tiān lěng

options.translation_text: Today is as cold as yesterday
options.pinyin: jīn tiān gēn zuó tiān yí yàng lěng

options.translation_text: Today is not as cold as yesterday
options.pinyin: jīn tiān méi yǒu zuó tiān lěng

questions.explanation_learning: “今天比昨天冷”用“比”比较两天的温度，说明今天的气温更低。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “jīn tiān bǐ zuó tiān lěng” yòng “bǐ” bǐ jiào liǎng tiān de wēn dù, shuō míng jīn tiān de qì wēn gèng dī.
questions.explanation_translation: 今天比昨天冷 compares the temperatures of today and yesterday and says that today is colder.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪种句型表示“A不如B……”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ zhǒng jù xíng biǎo shì bù rú
questions.prompt_translation: Which pattern means “A is not as ... as B”?

options.translation_text: A is not as ... as B
options.pinyin: A méi yǒu B nà me

questions.explanation_learning: “A没有B那么 + 形容词”表示A不具备B那么高的某种程度，即A不如B……。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “A méi yǒu B nà me + xíng róng cí” biǎo shì A bù jù bèi B nà me gāo de mǒu zhǒng chéng dù, jí A bù rú B.
questions.explanation_translation: A没有B那么 + adjective means A is not as [adjective] as B.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个词可以加强比较，表示“更加”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè cí kě yǐ jiā qiáng bǐ jiào biǎo shì gèng jiā
questions.prompt_translation: Which word can intensify a comparison, meaning “even more”?
questions.explanation_learning: “更”通常放在形容词前，加强比较程度，相当于“more”。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “gèng” tōng cháng fàng zài xíng róng cí qián, jiā qiáng bǐ jiào chéng dù.
questions.explanation_translation: 更 usually appears before an adjective to strengthen a comparison; it means “more.”

questions.prompt_learning: 哪一组关联词连接原因和结果？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ yī zǔ guān lián cí lián jiē yuán yīn hé jié guǒ
questions.prompt_translation: Which pair connects a reason with its result?
questions.explanation_learning: “因为”引出原因，“所以”引出结果，两者组成常见的因果关联结构。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “yīn wèi” yǐn chū yuán yīn, “suǒ yǐ” yǐn chū jié guǒ, liǎng zhě zǔ chéng cháng jiàn de yīn guǒ guān lián jié gòu.
questions.explanation_translation: 因为 introduces a reason and 所以 introduces its result; together they form a common cause-and-effect structure.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪一组关联词表示转折或让步？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ yī zǔ guān lián cí biǎo shì zhuǎn zhé huò ràng bù
questions.prompt_translation: Which pair expresses contrast or concession?
questions.explanation_learning: “虽然”引出让步情况，“但是”引出与预期形成对比的结果。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “suī rán” yǐn chū ràng bù qíng kuàng, “dàn shì” yǐn chū yǔ yù qī xíng chéng duì bǐ de jié guǒ.
questions.explanation_translation: 虽然 introduces a concession, and 但是 introduces the contrasting result.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪一组关联词表示条件及其结果？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ yī zǔ guān lián cí biǎo shì tiáo jiàn qí jié guǒ
questions.prompt_translation: Which pair expresses a condition and its result?
questions.explanation_learning: “如果”提出条件，“就”引出该条件成立时的结果。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “rú guǒ” tí chū tiáo jiàn, “jiù” yǐn chū gāi tiáo jiàn chéng lì shí de jié guǒ.
questions.explanation_translation: 如果 states a condition, and 就 introduces the result if that condition is met.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪一组关联词表示两个动作同时发生？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ yī zǔ guān lián cí biǎo shì liǎng gè dòng zuò tóng shí fā shēng
questions.prompt_translation: Which pair shows two actions happening at the same time?
questions.explanation_learning: “一边……一边……”表示同一个主体同时进行两个动作。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “yì biān… yì biān…” biǎo shì tóng yí gè zhǔ tǐ tóng shí jìn xíng liǎng gè dòng zuò.
questions.explanation_translation: 一边……一边…… indicates that the same subject performs two actions at the same time.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个句子表示“虽然她很累，但她仍继续学习”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè jù zǐ biǎo shì suī rán tā hěn lèi dàn tā réng jì xù xué xí
questions.prompt_translation: Which sentence means “Although she is tired, she continues studying”?

options.learning_text: 虽然很累，但是她继续学习
options.translation_text: Although she is tired, she continues studying
options.pinyin: suī rán hěn lèi, dàn shì tā jì xù xué xí

options.learning_text: 因为很累，所以她继续学习
options.translation_text: Because she is tired, she continues studying
options.pinyin: yīn wèi hěn lèi, suǒ yǐ tā jì xù xué xí

options.learning_text: 如果很累，就她继续学习
options.translation_text: If tired, then she continues studying
options.pinyin: rú guǒ hěn lèi, jiù tā jì xù xué xí

options.translation_text: She is first tired, then studies
options.pinyin: tā xiān hěn lèi, rán hòu xué xí

questions.explanation_learning: “虽然很累”先承认疲倦这一情况，“但是她继续学习”说明与之相反的行动。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “suī rán hěn lèi” xiān chéng rèn pí juàn zhè yí qíng kuàng, “dàn shì tā jì xù xué xí” shuō míng yǔ zhī xiāng fǎn de xíng dòng.
questions.explanation_translation: 虽然很累 acknowledges that she is tired, while 但是她继续学习 gives the contrasting action.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪一组关联词用于补充第二个更进一步的观点？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ yī zǔ guān lián cí yòng yú bǔ chōng dì èr gè gèng jìn yī bù de guān diǎn
questions.prompt_translation: Which pair adds a second, stronger point?
questions.explanation_learning: “不但”引出已有的一项情况，“而且”再补充更进一步的信息，表示“不仅……还……”。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “bù dàn” yǐn chū yǐ yǒu de yí xiàng qíng kuàng, “ér qiě” zài bǔ chōng gèng jìn yí bù de xìn xī.
questions.explanation_translation: 不但 introduces one point and 而且 adds a further point, together meaning “not only…but also.”

questions.prompt_learning: 下面哪句话使用“把”字句来说明如何处理一个物品？
questions.prompt_pinyin: xià miàn nǎ jù huà shǐ yòng “bǎ” zì jù lái shuō míng rú hé chǔ lǐ yí ge wù pǐn?
questions.prompt_translation: Which sentence uses 把 to show how an object is handled?
questions.explanation_learning: “把”字句把受影响的物品提前到动词前；“关上”说明关门这一动作达到关闭的结果。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “bǎ” zì jù bǎ shòu yǐng xiǎng de wù pǐn tí qián dào dòng cí qián; “guān shàng” shuō míng guān mén de dòng zuò dá dào guān bì de jié guǒ.
questions.explanation_translation: A 把 sentence places the affected object before the verb. 关上 expresses the result of closing the door.

questions.prompt_learning: “被”字句中的“被”主要起什么作用？
questions.prompt_pinyin: “bèi” zì jù zhōng de “bèi” zhǔ yào qǐ shén me zuò yòng?
questions.prompt_translation: What is the main function of 被 in a 被 sentence?

options.translation_text: To mark that the subject receives an action

options.pinyin: gòu chéng shì fēi wèn jù

questions.explanation_learning: “被”引出动作的施事者或来源，并说明主语承受动作，因此构成被动表达。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “bèi” yǐn chū dòng zuò de shī shì zhě huò lái yuán, bìng shuō míng zhǔ yǔ chéng shòu dòng zuò, yīn cǐ gòu chéng bèi dòng biǎo dá.
questions.explanation_translation: 被 introduces the agent or source of an action and shows that the subject receives the action, forming a passive construction.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪种句型表示“只有……才……”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ zhǒng jù xíng biǎo shì zhǐ yǒu cái
questions.prompt_translation: Which pattern means “Only if... can...”?
questions.explanation_learning: “只有”提出必要条件，“才”引出满足该条件后才会发生的结果。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “zhǐ yǒu” tí chū bì yào tiáo jiàn, “cái” yǐn chū mǎn zú gāi tiáo jiàn hòu cái huì fā shēng de jié guǒ.
questions.explanation_translation: 只有 states a necessary condition, and 才 introduces the result that follows only when the condition is met.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪种句型表示“不论条件如何，结果都不变”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ zhǒng jù xíng biǎo shì bù lùn tiáo jiàn rú jié guǒ dōu bù biàn
questions.prompt_translation: Which pattern means “No matter what the conditions are, the result still holds”?
questions.explanation_learning: “无论”表示条件不受限制，“都”强调在各种条件下结果保持一致。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “wú lùn” biǎo shì tiáo jiàn bù shòu xiàn zhì, “dōu” qiáng diào zài gè zhǒng tiáo jiàn xià jié guǒ bǎo chí yí zhì.
questions.explanation_translation: 无论 makes the condition unrestricted, while 都 emphasises that the result remains the same in every case.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个句子表示“我的手机被弟弟拿走了”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè jù zǐ biǎo shì wǒ de shǒu jī bèi dì dì ná zǒu le
questions.prompt_translation: Which sentence means “My phone was taken away by my younger brother”?

options.learning_text: 我的手机被弟弟拿走了
options.translation_text: My phone was taken away by my younger brother
options.pinyin: wǒ de shǒu jī bèi dì di ná zǒu le

options.translation_text: I took my younger brother away
options.pinyin: wǒ bǎ dì di ná zǒu le

options.translation_text: My younger brother saw the phone
options.pinyin: dì di bǎ shǒu jī kàn jiàn le

options.translation_text: The phone is beside my younger brother
options.pinyin: shǒu jī zài dì di páng biān

questions.explanation_learning: 这是被动句：手机是承受动作的对象，“被弟弟”指出动作执行者，“拿走了”说明结果。
questions.explanation_pinyin: zhè shì bèi dòng jù: shǒu jī shì chéng shòu dòng zuò de duì xiàng, “bèi dì di” zhǐ chū dòng zuò zhí xíng zhě, “ná zǒu le” shuō míng jié guǒ.
questions.explanation_translation: This is a passive sentence: the phone receives the action, 被弟弟 names the agent, and 拿走了 gives the result.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪种句型以已知事实作为得出结论的理由？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ zhǒng jù xíng yǐ yǐ zhī shì shí zuò wèi dé chū jié lùn de lǐ yóu
questions.prompt_translation: Which pattern uses an established fact as the reason for a conclusion?
questions.explanation_learning: “既然”引出已经确认的事实，“就”连接根据该事实得出的结论或后续安排。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “jì rán” yǐn chū yǐ jīng què rèn de shì shí, “jiù” lián jiē gēn jù gāi shì shí dé chū de jié lùn huò hòu xù ān pái.
questions.explanation_translation: 既然 introduces an accepted fact, and 就 links it to a conclusion or next step based on that fact.

questions.prompt_learning: 下面哪一句是自然、正确的“把”字句？
questions.prompt_pinyin: xià miàn nǎ yí jù shì zì rán, zhèng què de “bǎ” zì jù?
questions.prompt_translation: Which is a natural 把 sentence?

options.pinyin: wǒ bǎ zuò yè xiě wán le

questions.explanation_learning: “我把作业写完了”中，“把”提前宾语“作业”，“写完”表示动作达到完成的结果。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “wǒ bǎ zuò yè xiě wán le” zhōng, “bǎ” tí qián bīn yǔ “zuò yè”, “xiě wán” biǎo shì dòng zuò dá dào wán chéng de jié guǒ.
questions.explanation_translation: In 我把作业写完了, 把 moves the object 作业 before the verb, and 写完 indicates the result of finishing the work.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个连接词用于引出结果或结论？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè lián jiē cí yòng yú yǐn chū jié guǒ huò jié lùn
questions.prompt_translation: Which connector introduces a result or conclusion?
questions.explanation_learning: “因此”承接前面的原因或事实，引出由此得出的结果或结论。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “yīn cǐ” chéng jiē qián miàn de yuán yīn huò shì shí, yǐn chū yóu cǐ dé chū de jié guǒ huò jié lùn.
questions.explanation_translation: 因此 connects to a preceding reason or fact and introduces the resulting conclusion or consequence.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个连接词表示“然而”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè lián jiē cí biǎo shì rán ér
questions.prompt_translation: Which connector means “however”?
questions.explanation_learning: “然而”用于连接两个形成转折或对比的分句，语气通常比“但是”更书面。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “rán ér” yòng yú lián jiē liǎng gè xíng chéng zhuǎn zhé huò duì bǐ de fēn jù, yǔ qì tōng cháng bǐ “dàn shì” gèng shū miàn.
questions.explanation_translation: 然而 links clauses that contrast with each other and is generally more formal or written than 但是.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个连接词用于补充信息，表示“此外”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè lián jiē cí yòng yú bǔ chōng xìn xī biǎo shì cǐ wài
questions.prompt_translation: Which connector adds information, meaning “in addition”?
questions.explanation_learning: “此外”用于补充前面没有提到的信息，相当于“另外”或“除此之外”。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “cǐ wài” yòng yú bǔ chōng qián miàn méi yǒu tí dào de xìn xī, xiāng dāng yú “lìng wài” huò “chú cǐ zhī wài”.
questions.explanation_translation: 此外 adds information not mentioned earlier; it means “in addition” or “besides.”

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个词用于概括讨论，表示“总之”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè cí yòng yú gài kuò tǎo lùn biǎo shì zhī
questions.prompt_translation: Which word summarises a discussion as “in short”?
questions.explanation_learning: “总之”用于概括前面的讨论或重点，并引出简要总结。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “zǒng zhī” yòng yú gài kuò qián miàn de tǎo lùn huò zhòng diǎn, bìng yǐn chū jiǎn yào zǒng jié.
questions.explanation_translation: 总之 signals a summary of the preceding discussion or main points.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个连接词表示结果与预期相反？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè lián jiē cí biǎo shì jié guǒ yǔ yù qī xiāng fǎn
questions.prompt_translation: Which connector marks a result opposite to expectation?
questions.explanation_learning: “反而”表示实际结果与原先预期相反，常用于强调意外的转变。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “fǎn ér” biǎo shì shí jì jié guǒ yǔ yuán xiān yù qī xiāng fǎn, cháng yòng yú qiáng diào yì wài de zhuǎn biàn.
questions.explanation_translation: 反而 indicates that the actual result is the opposite of what was expected, often highlighting an unexpected turn.

questions.prompt_learning: 下面哪句话自然地使用了表示转折的连接词“然而”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: xià miàn nǎ jù huà zì rán de shǐ yòng le biǎo shì zhuǎn zhé de lián jiē cí “rán ér”?
questions.prompt_translation: Which sentence uses 然而 naturally?

options.learning_text: 天气很冷，然而他还是出门了
options.translation_text: It was cold; however, he still went out
options.pinyin: tiān qì hěn lěng, rán ér tā hái shi chū mén le

options.learning_text: 天气很冷，因此他还是出门了
options.translation_text: It was cold; therefore, he still went out
options.pinyin: tiān qì hěn lěng, yīn cǐ tā hái shi chū mén le

options.learning_text: 天气很冷，总之他还是出门了
options.translation_text: It was cold; in short, he still went out
options.pinyin: tiān qì hěn lěng, zǒng zhī tā hái shi chū mén le

options.learning_text: 天气很冷，此外他还是出门了
options.translation_text: It was cold; in addition, he still went out
options.pinyin: tiān qì hěn lěng, cǐ wài tā hái shi chū mén le

questions.explanation_learning: 前半句说明天气很冷，“然而”引出与通常预期相反的情况：他仍然出门。
questions.explanation_pinyin: qián bàn jù shuō míng tiān qì hěn lěng, “rán ér” yǐn chū yǔ tōng cháng yù qī xiāng fǎn de qíng kuàng: tā réng rán chū mén.
questions.explanation_translation: The first clause says the weather is cold; 然而 introduces the contrasting, unexpected fact that he still goes out.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个连接词可以引出某种情况之后接着发生的动作，类似“于是”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè lián jiē cí kě yǐ yǐn chū mǒu zhǒng qíng kuàng zhī hòu jiē zhe fā shēng de dòng zuò lèi sì yú shì
questions.prompt_translation: Which connector can introduce an action that follows a situation, similar to “thereupon”?
questions.explanation_learning: “于是”常引出前面情况导致的后续行动或结果，强调事情接着发生。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “yú shì” cháng yǐn chū qián miàn qíng kuàng dǎo zhì de hòu xù xíng dòng huò jié guǒ, qiáng diào shì qíng jiē zhe fā shēng.
questions.explanation_translation: 于是 often introduces a subsequent action or result caused by the preceding situation, emphasising what happened next.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个表达表示“画蛇添足”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè biǎo dá biǎo shì huà tiān zú
questions.prompt_translation: Which expression means ruining something by adding unnecessary details?

options.translation_text: To ruin something by overdoing it
To mend the fold after a sheep is lost
To achieve two things at once
When in Rome, do as the Romans do

questions.explanation_learning: “画蛇添足”比喻做了多余的事，反而破坏原本已经完成或良好的结果。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “huà shé tiān zú” bǐ yù zuò le duō yú de shì, fǎn ér pò huài yuán běn yǐ jīng wán chéng huò liáng hǎo de jié guǒ.
questions.explanation_translation: 画蛇添足 describes doing something unnecessary that spoils an otherwise complete or good result.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个成语表示“出了问题后及时补救”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè chéng yǔ biǎo shì chū le wèn tí hòu shí bǔ jiù
questions.prompt_translation: Which idiom means taking corrective action after a problem has occurred?

options.translation_text: Mend the fold after losing a sheep

questions.explanation_learning: “亡羊补牢”比喻出了问题后及时采取补救措施，避免损失继续扩大。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “wáng yáng bǔ láo” bǐ yù chū le wèn tí hòu jí shí cǎi qǔ bǔ jiù cuò shī, bì miǎn sǔn shī jì xù kuò dà.
questions.explanation_translation: 亡羊补牢 means taking corrective action after a problem occurs to prevent further loss.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个表达表示“一举两得”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè biǎo dá biǎo shì yī jǔ liǎng dé
questions.prompt_translation: Which expression means “to achieve two things with one action”?
questions.explanation_learning: “一举两得”表示采取一个行动，同时获得两个好处或达到两个目的。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “yì jǔ liǎng dé” biǎo shì cǎi qǔ yí gè xíng dòng, tóng shí huò dé liǎng gè hǎo chù huò dá dào liǎng gè mù dì.
questions.explanation_translation: 一举两得 means achieving two benefits or goals with one action.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪句谚语强调努力与收获之间的关系？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ jù yǔ qiáng diào nǔ lì yǔ shōu huò zhī jiān de guān xì
questions.prompt_translation: Which saying is a proverb about effort and results?

options.pinyin: yì fēn gēng yún, yì fēn shōu huò

questions.explanation_learning: “一分耕耘，一分收获”强调付出与收获之间的关系：努力通常带来相应成果。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “yì fēn gēng yún, yì fēn shōu huò” qiáng diào fù chū yǔ shōu huò zhī jiān de guān xì: nǔ lì tōng cháng dài lái xiāng yìng chéng guǒ.
questions.explanation_translation: 一分耕耘，一分收获 emphasises the relationship between effort and reward: work generally brings corresponding results.

questions.prompt_learning: 成语和谚语之间最重要的区别是什么？
questions.prompt_pinyin: chéng yǔ hé yàn yǔ zhī jiān zuì zhòng yào de qū bié shì shén me?
questions.prompt_translation: What is a key difference between 成语 and 谚语?

options.learning_text: 成语是固定的惯用表达；谚语是民间格言或俗语
options.translation_text: Idioms are fixed expressions; proverbs express folk wisdom
options.pinyin: chéng yǔ shì gù dìng de guàn yòng biǎo dá; yàn yǔ shì mín jiān gé yán huò sú yǔ
liǎng zhě wán quán xiāng tóng
chéng yǔ dōu shì xiàn dài lǐ yǔ
yàn yǔ dōu zhǐ yǒu sì ge zì

questions.explanation_learning: 成语通常是结构固定、含义凝练的惯用表达；谚语则多是流传于民间、表达经验或道理的句子。
questions.explanation_pinyin: chéng yǔ tōng cháng shì jié gòu gù dìng, hán yì níng liàn de guàn yòng biǎo dá; yàn yǔ zé duō shì liú chuán yú mín jiān, biǎo dá jīng yàn huò dào lǐ de jù zi.
questions.explanation_translation: An idiom is usually a fixed, compact expression with an established meaning; a proverb is a saying passed down in everyday culture that conveys experience or advice.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个表达劝人入乡随俗？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè biǎo dá quàn rén rù suí
questions.prompt_translation: Which expression advises people to follow local customs?

options.translation_text: When in Rome, do as the Romans do
Correct a problem after it happens

questions.explanation_learning: “入乡随俗”劝人在新的地方尊重并遵循当地的习惯和规矩。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “rù xiāng suí sú” quàn rén zài xīn de dì fāng zūn zhòng bìng zūn xún dāng dì de xí guàn hé guī ju.
questions.explanation_translation: 入乡随俗 advises people to respect and follow local customs when they are in a new place.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个表达最适合形容在已经很好的设计上添加不必要的功能？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè biǎo dá zuì shì hé xíng róng zài yǐ jīng hěn hǎo de shè jì shàng tiān jiā bù bì yào de gōng néng
questions.prompt_translation: Which expression best fits someone adding unnecessary features to an already good design?

options.pinyin: yì fēn gēng yún, yì fēn shōu huò

questions.explanation_learning: 在已经很好的设计上添加不必要的功能，会让结果变得多余甚至更差，正符合“画蛇添足”的意思。
questions.explanation_pinyin: zài yǐ jīng hěn hǎo de shè jì shàng tiān jiā bù bì yào de gōng néng, huì ràng jié guǒ biàn dé duō yú shèn zhì gèng chà, zhè zhèng fú hé “huà shé tiān zú” de yì si.
questions.explanation_translation: Adding unnecessary features to an already good design makes it excessive or worse, which is exactly what 画蛇添足 describes.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个词常表示某事发生得比预期晚？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè cí cháng biǎo shì mǒu shì fā shēng dé bǐ yù qī wǎn
questions.prompt_translation: Which word often suggests that something happened later than expected?
questions.explanation_learning: “才”在时间表达中常强调事情发生得较晚，或比预期更迟，例如“他十点才来”。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “cái” zài shí jiān biǎo dá zhōng cháng qiáng diào shì qíng fā shēng de jiào wǎn, huò bǐ yù qī gèng chí, lì rú “tā shí diǎn cái lái”.
questions.explanation_translation: In time expressions, 才 often emphasises that something happens late or later than expected, as in 他十点才来.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个词强调经过较长过程后终于达到结果？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè cí qiáng diào jīng guò jiào zhǎng guò chéng hòu zhōng yú dá dào jié guǒ
questions.prompt_translation: Which word stresses that a result was reached after a long process?
questions.explanation_learning: “终于”强调经过等待、努力或一段过程后，某个结果最后出现。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “zhōng yú” qiáng diào jīng guò děng dài, nǔ lì huò yí duàn guò chéng hòu, mǒu gè jié guǒ zuì hòu chū xiàn.
questions.explanation_translation: 终于 emphasises that a result finally happens after waiting, effort or a process.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个词常表示了解事实或熟悉某种情况？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè cí cháng biǎo shì le jiě shì shí huò shú xī mǒu zhǒng qíng kuàng
questions.prompt_translation: Which word often means understanding facts or becoming familiar with a situation?
questions.explanation_learning: “了解”表示掌握某件事的情况或相关信息，程度通常比单纯听说更深入。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “liǎo jiě” biǎo shì zhǎng wò mǒu jiàn shì de qíng kuàng huò xiāng guān xìn xī, chéng dù tōng cháng bǐ dān chún tīng shuō gèng shēn rù.
questions.explanation_translation: 了解 means to understand or be informed about a situation, usually beyond merely having heard of it.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个动词表示创造新事物，例如一种设备？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè dòng cí biǎo shì chuàng zào xīn shì wù lì rú yī zhǒng shè bèi
questions.prompt_translation: Which verb means to create something new, such as a device?
questions.explanation_learning: “发明”表示创造以前不存在的新事物或新方法；它不同于发现已经存在的事物。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “fā míng” biǎo shì chuàng zào yǐ qián bù cún zài de xīn shì wù huò xīn fāng fǎ; tā bù tóng yú “fā xiàn”.
questions.explanation_translation: 发明 means to create something or a method that did not exist before; it differs from 发现, which means to discover something that already exists.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个表达表示“这本书适合初学者”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè biǎo dá biǎo shì zhè běn shū shì hé chū xué zhě
questions.prompt_translation: Which expression means “This book is suitable for beginners”?

options.translation_text: This book is suitable for beginners
options.pinyin: zhè běn shū shì hé chū xué zhě
zhè běn shū fā xiàn chū xué zhě
zhè běn shū fā míng chū xué zhě
zhè běn shū zhōng yú chū xué zhě

questions.explanation_learning: “适合”表示某人或某物符合特定需要或条件；“适合初学者”就是适用于刚开始学习的人。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “shì hé” biǎo shì mǒu rén huò mǒu wù fú hé tè dìng xū yào huò tiáo jiàn; “shì hé chū xué zhě” jiù shì shì yòng yú gāng kāi shǐ xué xí de rén.
questions.explanation_translation: 适合 means to be suitable for a particular need or condition. 适合初学者 means suitable for beginners.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个词强调某个人或事物特别突出？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè cí qiáng diào mǒu gè rén huò shì wù tè bié tū chū
questions.prompt_translation: Which word highlights a particularly notable item or person?
questions.explanation_learning: “尤其”用于突出某个人、事物或情况，表示它比其他对象更值得注意。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “yóu qí” yòng yú tū chū mǒu gè rén, shì wù huò qíng kuàng, biǎo shì tā bǐ qí tā duì xiàng gèng zhí dé zhù yì.
questions.explanation_translation: 尤其 highlights a person, thing or situation as particularly noteworthy compared with others.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个词可以引出极端或令人惊讶的例子，表示“甚至”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè cí kě yǐ yǐn chū jí huò lìng rén jīng yà de lì zǐ biǎo shì zhì
questions.prompt_translation: Which word can introduce an extreme or surprising example, meaning “even”?
questions.explanation_learning: “甚至”引出程度更深或更极端的例子，表示某种情况超出一般预期。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “shèn zhì” yǐn chū chéng dù gèng shēn huò gèng jí duān de lì zi, biǎo shì mǒu zhǒng qíng kuàng chāo chū yì bān yù qī.
questions.explanation_translation: 甚至 introduces an even stronger or more extreme example, showing that something goes beyond ordinary expectations.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个表达可以自然地回应道歉？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè biǎo dá kě yǐ zì rán de huí yīng dào qiàn
questions.prompt_translation: Which expression naturally responds to an apology?
questions.explanation_learning: “没关系”常用于回应道歉，表示不必介意或事情没有造成严重影响。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “méi guān xi” cháng yòng yú huí yìng dào qiàn, biǎo shì bù bì jiè yì huò shì qíng méi yǒu zào chéng yán zhòng yǐng xiǎng.
questions.explanation_translation: 没关系 is a common response to an apology, meaning “it's okay” or “don't worry about it.”

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个表达可以表示对他人付出的认可？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè biǎo dá kě yǐ biǎo shì duì tā rén chū de rèn kě
questions.prompt_translation: Which expression acknowledges someone's effort?
questions.explanation_learning: “辛苦了”用于认可别人付出的努力或辛劳，常在对方完成工作后表达体谅和感谢。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “xīn kǔ le” yòng yú rèn kě bié rén fù chū de nǔ lì huò xīn láo, cháng zài duì fāng wán chéng gōng zuò hòu biǎo dá tǐ liàng hé gǎn xiè.
questions.explanation_translation: 辛苦了 acknowledges someone's effort or hard work and is often said after they have completed a task.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪一首诗包含“床前明月光，疑是地上霜”这一句？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ yì shǒu shī bāo hán “chuáng qián míng yuè guāng, yí shì dì shàng shuāng” zhè yí jù?
questions.prompt_translation: Which poem contains the line 床前明月光，疑是地上霜？
questions.explanation_learning: “床前明月光，疑是地上霜”是唐代诗人李白《静夜思》的开头两句。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “chuáng qián míng yuè guāng, yí shì dì shàng shuāng” shì táng dài shī rén Lǐ Bái “jìng yè sī” de kāi tóu liǎng jù.
questions.explanation_translation: “床前明月光，疑是地上霜” are the opening two lines of 静夜思 by the Tang poet Li Bai.

questions.prompt_learning: 唐代诗歌《静夜思》的作者是谁？
questions.prompt_pinyin: táng dài shī gē “jìng yè sī” de zuò zhě shì shéi?
questions.prompt_translation: Who wrote the Tang-dynasty poem 静夜思?
questions.explanation_learning: 李白是唐代著名诗人，常被称为“诗仙”；《静夜思》是他的代表作之一。
questions.explanation_pinyin: Lǐ Bái shì táng dài zhù míng shī rén, cháng bèi chēng wéi “shī xiān”; “jìng yè sī” shì tā de dài biǎo zuò zhī yī.
questions.explanation_translation: Li Bai was a renowned Tang dynasty poet, often called the “Immortal Poet.” 静夜思 is one of his best-known works.

questions.prompt_learning: 《静夜思》的开头两句把什么事物进行比较？
questions.prompt_pinyin: “jìng yè sī” de kāi tóu liǎng jù bǎ shén me shì wù jìn xíng bǐ jiào?
questions.prompt_translation: What does the opening couplet of 静夜思 compare?
questions.explanation_learning: 诗句把明亮的月光看作地上的白霜，表现诗人夜间醒来时的视觉感受。
questions.explanation_pinyin: shī jù bǎ míng liàng de yuè guāng kàn zuò dì shàng de bái shuāng, biǎo xiàn shī rén yè jiān xǐng lái shí de shì jué gǎn shòu.
questions.explanation_translation: The lines compare the bright moonlight to white frost on the ground, describing the poet's visual impression at night.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪句古语出自《荀子·劝学》，强调逐步积累的重要性？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ jù gǔ yǔ chū zì zǐ quàn xué qiáng diào bù jī lèi de zhòng yào xìng
questions.prompt_translation: Which classical saying is from Xunzi's Encouraging Learning and stresses gradual accumulation?

options.translation_text: Without small steps, one cannot travel a thousand miles
options.pinyin: bù jī kuǐ bù, wú yǐ zhì qiān lǐ

questions.explanation_learning: “不积跬步，无以至千里”出自《荀子·劝学》，说明远大目标需要从小步积累开始。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “bù jī kuǐ bù, wú yǐ zhì qiān lǐ” chū zì “xún zǐ · quàn xué”, shuō míng yuǎn dà mù biāo xū yào cóng xiǎo bù jī lěi kāi shǐ.
questions.explanation_translation: “不积跬步，无以至千里” comes from Xunzi's 勸學 and teaches that great goals require steady accumulation of small steps.

questions.prompt_learning: 你以前去过北京吗？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǐ qù guò běi jīng ma?
questions.prompt_translation: Have you been to Beijing before?

options.translation_text: marks a completed change or action
links a modifier to a noun

questions.explanation_learning: “过”放在动词“去”后，表示以前有去北京的经历；句末“吗”把句子变成是非疑问句。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “guo” fàng zài dòng cí “qù” hòu, biǎo shì yǐ qián yǒu qù běi jīng de jīng lì; jù mò “ma” bǎ jù zi biàn chéng shì fǒu yí wèn jù.
questions.explanation_translation: 过 after 去 marks past experience, while sentence-final 吗 turns the statement into a yes/no question.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪句话最自然地表示“我每天早上跑步”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ jù huà zuì zì rán de biǎo shì “wǒ měi tiān zǎo shang pǎo bù”?
questions.prompt_translation: Which sentence most naturally means “I go running every morning”?

options.pinyin: wǒ měi tiān zǎo shang pǎo bù
wǒ pǎo bù měi tiān zǎo shang
měi tiān wǒ pǎo bù zǎo shang
wǒ zǎo shang pǎo bù měi tiān

questions.explanation_learning: “每天早上”说明动作发生的固定时间，“跑步”是表示运动的动词短语。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “měi tiān zǎo shang” shuō míng dòng zuò fā shēng de gù dìng shí jiān, “pǎo bù” shì biǎo shì yùn dòng de dòng cí duǎn yǔ.
questions.explanation_translation: 每天早上 gives the recurring time of the action, and 跑步 is the verb phrase meaning “to run.”

questions.prompt_learning: 哪句话正确地使用“把”字句表示“请寄出这封信”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ jù huà zhèng què de shǐ yòng “bǎ” zì jù biǎo dá “qǐng jì chū zhè fēng xìn”?
questions.prompt_translation: Which sentence correctly uses a 把 construction to say “Please send this letter”?

options.pinyin: qǐng bǎ zhè fēng xìn jì chū qù

options.translation_text: Incorrect: 喜欢 does not take this 把-object pattern here.
options.pinyin: qǐng bǎ hěn xǐ huan zhè fēng xìn
qǐng bǎ zhè fēng xìn shì xīn de
qǐng bǎ míng tiān zài jiā

questions.explanation_learning: “把这封信”提前说明受处理的对象，“寄出去”表示把信寄离说话者所在的位置。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “bǎ zhè fēng xìn” tí qián shuō míng shòu chǔ lǐ de duì xiàng, “jì chū qù” biǎo shì bǎ xìn jì lí shuō huà zhě suǒ zài de wèi zhì.
questions.explanation_translation: 把这封信 identifies the letter being handled, and 寄出去 means to send it away from the speaker's location.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪句话自然地表示“我的自行车被人偷了”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ jù huà zì rán de biǎo dá “wǒ de zì xíng chē bèi rén tōu le”?
questions.prompt_translation: Which sentence naturally means “My bicycle was stolen”?

options.pinyin: wǒ de zì xíng chē bèi rén tōu le
wǒ bǎ zì xíng chē qí zǒu le

options.translation_text: The bicycle is outside the door.
options.pinyin: zì xíng chē zài mén wài
wǒ mǎi le yí liàng zì xíng chē

questions.explanation_learning: “我的自行车”是承受动作的主语，“被人”表示施事者不具体，“偷了”说明发生了偷窃。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “wǒ de zì xíng chē” shì chéng shòu dòng zuò de zhǔ yǔ, “bèi rén” biǎo shì shī shì zhě bù jù tǐ, “tōu le” shuō míng fā shēng le tōu qiè.
questions.explanation_translation: 我的自行车 is the subject receiving the action; 被人 leaves the agent unspecified, and 偷了 states that it was stolen.

questions.prompt_learning: 只有努力，才能成功。
questions.prompt_pinyin: zhǐ yǒu nǔ lì, cái néng chéng gōng.
questions.prompt_translation: Only through effort can one succeed.
questions.explanation_learning: “只有努力”提出必要条件，“才能成功”说明成功必须以努力为前提。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “zhǐ yǒu nǔ lì” tí chū bì yào tiáo jiàn, “cái néng chéng gōng” shuō míng chéng gōng bì xū yǐ nǔ lì wéi qián tí.
questions.explanation_translation: 只有努力 states the necessary condition, and 才能成功 says that success depends on meeting it.

questions.prompt_learning: 无论多忙，他都会回信。
questions.prompt_pinyin: wú lùn duō máng, tā dōu huì huí xìn.
questions.prompt_translation: No matter how busy he is, he always replies.
questions.explanation_learning: “无论多忙”表示忙碌程度不构成限制，“都会回信”说明结果始终如此。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “wú lùn duō máng” biǎo shì máng lù chéng dù bù gòu chéng xiàn zhì, “dōu huì huí xìn” shuō míng jié guǒ shǐ zhōng rú cǐ.
questions.explanation_translation: 无论多忙 means that any level of busyness is no obstacle; 都会回信 states the consistent result.

questions.prompt_learning: 画蛇添足
questions.prompt_pinyin: huà shé tiān zú
questions.prompt_translation: To ruin something by adding unnecessary details.

options.translation_text: Adding unnecessary things and making it worse.
options.pinyin: duō cǐ yì jǔ, fǎn ér huài shì
zuò shì fēi cháng xùn sù

options.translation_text: Working together to finish a task.
options.pinyin: tuán jié hé zuò wán chéng rèn wù
cóng cuò wù zhōng xī qǔ jiào xùn

questions.explanation_learning: “多此一举”说明这个行动没有必要；“反而坏事”指出多余的做法可能让结果变差。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “duō cǐ yì jǔ” shuō míng zhè ge xíng dòng méi yǒu bì yào; “fǎn ér huài shì” zhǐ chū duō yú de zuò fǎ kě néng ràng jié guǒ biàn chà.
questions.explanation_translation: 多此一举 says the action is unnecessary, while 反而坏事 explains that the extra action may make things worse.

questions.prompt_learning: 入乡随俗
questions.prompt_pinyin: rù xiāng suí sú
questions.prompt_translation: Follow local customs when in a new place.

options.learning_text: 到一个地方就遵循当地习俗
options.pinyin: dào yí gè dì fāng jiù zūn xún dāng dì xí sú

options.translation_text: Leave home to find a new job.
options.pinyin: lí kāi jiā xiāng xún zhǎo xīn gōng zuò

options.learning_text: 保持自己的生活习惯不变
options.pinyin: bǎo chí zì jǐ de shēng huó xí guàn bú biàn

options.learning_text: 旅行时只吃熟悉的食物
options.translation_text: Eat only familiar food while travelling.
options.pinyin: lǚ xíng shí zhǐ chī shú xī de shí wù

questions.explanation_learning: 这句话解释“入乡随俗”：到新的地方后，按当地习俗行事。
questions.explanation_pinyin: zhè jù huà jiě shì “rù xiāng suí sú”: dào xīn de dì fāng hòu, àn dāng dì xí sú xíng shì.
questions.explanation_translation: This explains 入乡随俗: when you go somewhere new, follow the customs of that place.

questions.prompt_learning: 他做事很细心。
questions.prompt_pinyin: tā zuò shì hěn xì xīn.
questions.prompt_translation: He is very meticulous.
questions.explanation_learning: “细心”形容做事认真、留意细节，不容易忽略小地方。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “xì xīn” xíng róng zuò shì rèn zhēn, liú yì xì jié, bù róng yì hū lüè xiǎo dì fāng.
questions.explanation_translation: 细心 describes being careful and attentive to details rather than overlooking small things.

questions.prompt_learning: 公司决定公开这些资料。
questions.prompt_pinyin: gōng sī jué dìng gōng kāi zhè xiē zī liào.
questions.prompt_translation: The company decided to disclose this information.
questions.explanation_learning: “公开”表示让原本不公开的信息、资料或活动向公众开放或可被大家知道。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “gōng kāi” biǎo shì ràng yuán běn bù gōng kāi de xìn xī, zī liào huò huó dòng xiàng gōng zhòng kāi fàng huò kě bèi dà jiā zhī dào.
questions.explanation_translation: 公开 means making information, materials or an event that was not public accessible or known to the public.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪个成语表示“一个行动同时带来两个好处”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ gè chéng yǔ biǎo shì “yí gè xíng dòng tóng shí dài lái liǎng gè hǎo chù”?
questions.prompt_translation: Which idiom means that one action brings two benefits?
questions.explanation_learning: “一举两得”强调一个行动同时带来两个好处，因此适合概括兼顾两项目标的做法。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “yì jǔ liǎng dé” qiáng diào yí gè xíng dòng tóng shí dài lái liǎng gè hǎo chù, yīn cǐ shì hé gài kuò jiān gù liǎng xiàng mù biāo de zuò fǎ.
questions.explanation_translation: 一举两得 describes one action that brings two benefits, making it suitable for a solution that achieves two goals at once.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪一句诗开头描写春日睡醒时天已亮？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ yí jù shī kāi tóu miáo xiě chūn rì shuì xǐng shí tiān yǐ jīng liàng?
questions.prompt_translation: Which poem line opens with a description of waking after dawn on a spring day?

options.translation_text: Spring sleep makes one unaware of dawn.
Raising one's head to look at the moon.
The sun sets behind the mountains.

questions.explanation_learning: “春眠不觉晓”是孟浩然《春晓》的开头，描写春日睡醒时天已亮的情景。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “chūn mián bù jué xiǎo” shì Mèng Hào Rán “chūn xiǎo” de kāi tóu, miáo xiě chūn rì shuì xǐng shí tiān yǐ jīng liàng le de qíng jǐng.
questions.explanation_translation: “春眠不觉晓” opens 孟浩然's poem 春晓 and describes waking from spring sleep after dawn has arrived.

questions.prompt_learning: 如果明天下雨，我就不去了。
questions.prompt_pinyin: rú guǒ míng tiān xià yǔ, wǒ jiù bú qù le.
questions.prompt_translation: If it rains tomorrow, I will not go.
questions.explanation_learning: “如果”提出明天下雨这一条件，“就”引出条件成立时不去的结果。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “rú guǒ” tí chū míng tiān xià yǔ zhè yí tiáo jiàn, “jiù” yǐn chū tiáo jiàn chéng lì shí bù qù de jié guǒ.
questions.explanation_translation: 如果 introduces the condition that it rains tomorrow, and 就 gives the result: the speaker will not go.

questions.prompt_learning: 虽然他很累，但是还是完成了工作。
questions.prompt_pinyin: suī rán tā hěn lèi, dàn shì hái shì wán chéng le gōng zuò.
questions.prompt_translation: Although he was tired, he still finished the work.
questions.explanation_learning: “虽然”引出他很累这一让步事实，“但是”强调他仍然完成工作。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “suī rán” yǐn chū tā hěn lèi zhè yí ràng bù shì shí, “dàn shì” qiáng diào tā réng rán wán chéng gōng zuò.
questions.explanation_translation: 虽然 introduces the concession that he is tired, while 但是 emphasises that he completes the work anyway.

questions.prompt_learning: 自相矛盾
questions.prompt_pinyin: zì xiāng máo dùn
questions.prompt_translation: To contradict oneself.

options.translation_text: One's own statements contradict each other.
options.pinyin: zì jǐ de shuō fǎ hù xiāng chōng tū

options.translation_text: Two people share the same opinion.
options.pinyin: liǎng gè rén yì jiàn wán quán xiāng tóng
jiě jué yí gè fù zá wèn tí
yǒng gǎn miàn duì kùn nán

questions.explanation_learning: “自相矛盾”形容同一个人的说法或行为彼此冲突，不能同时成立。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “zì xiāng máo dùn” xíng róng tóng yí gè rén de shuō fǎ huò xíng wéi bǐ cǐ chōng tū, bù néng tóng shí chéng lì.
questions.explanation_translation: 自相矛盾 describes a person's own statements or actions contradicting each other so that they cannot all be true.

questions.prompt_learning: 哪一句最自然地表达“请你先考虑清楚，再作决定”？
questions.prompt_pinyin: nǎ yí jù zuì zì rán de biǎo dá “qǐng nǐ xiān kǎo lǜ qīng chu, zài zuò jué dìng”?
questions.prompt_translation: Which sentence most naturally means “Please think it through before making a decision”?

options.pinyin: qǐng nǐ sān sī ér hòu xíng
qǐng nǐ huà shé tiān zú
qǐng nǐ rù xiāng suí sú

options.translation_text: Please achieve two things at once.
options.pinyin: qǐng nǐ yì jǔ liǎng dé

questions.explanation_learning: “三思而后行”劝人行动或作决定前先仔细考虑，避免仓促行事。
questions.explanation_pinyin: “sān sī ér hòu xíng” quàn rén xíng dòng huò zuò jué dìng qián xiān zǐ xì kǎo lǜ, bì miǎn cāng cù xíng shì.
questions.explanation_translation: 三思而后行 advises someone to think carefully before acting or deciding, rather than rushing.
